backend/main.mo: Implements event submission and updating, processes golfer scores, and computes Callaway results using a static chart and sorting logic.
backend/migration.mo: Provides a no-op migration stub converting an old actor state to a new empty state.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries mapping feature IDs to affected files, components, and test IDs with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for all frontend source files including components, state modules, and Callaway utilities.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes with global styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading the main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component coordinating setup, score entry, calculation, leaderboard display, and admin/settings navigation.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminView.ts: Admin panel wrapper enforcing access control and rendering the CallawayChartEditor when enabled.
frontend/src/features/admin/CallawayChar: Provides an editor UI for modifying 9- and 18‑hole Callaway grid charts with validation and save/reset actions.
frontend/src/features/eventSetup/EventSe: Form for entering tournament setup details and submitting an EventSetup object.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Breakd: Displays a player's detailed Callaway scoring breakdown including gross, deductions, adjustments, and net.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Callaw: Renders the Callaway scoring chart table and a brief explanation of how the system works.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Leader: Shows ranked Callaway results in a sortable table with rank icons and formatted scores.
Full leaderboard page combining standings, chart display, and individual score breakdowns.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/GolferS: UI for entering golfer names and per‑hole gross scores, updating parent state on changes.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/validat: Validates golfer input data including name, hole count, and reasonable per‑hole scores.
frontend/src/features/settings/SettingsV: Renders a settings screen with a toggle for admin access stored in localStorage and a back button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on the user's Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and stored identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks using the backend actor, currently providing a latest result query.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global styles, Tailwind setup, and light/dark theme variables for a golf-themed UI.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callaway.ts: Computes Callaway handicap results from hole scores using active chart data, returning gross, deduction, adjustment, and net scores.
Contains default Callaway scoring charts for 9 and 18 holes and a helper to select the correct chart entry by gross score.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartP: Manages localStorage persistence for edited Callaway charts and provides default grid chart data for 9‑ and 18‑hole charts.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/state/adminAccess.ts: Handles reading and writing the admin access enabled flag in localStorage.
frontend/src/state/eventTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for event setup, golfer input data, and Callaway scoring results.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, existing features, and pending feature requests for the Callaway chart editor update.
